description: Returns three views of one domain already added to this app (never any other domain): what public DNS shows now — the A, AAAA, CNAME and TXT records at the domain, its www and _gemmein, read from 3 fixed public DNS servers (Cloudflare (1.1.1.1), Google (8.8.8.8), Quad9 (9.9.9.9)), with how long each answer is cached and how many of the servers already see each record Gemmein needs; what Gemmein needs for this app; and Gemmein's verdict — whether the domain is proved yours, whether the Live site shows there (connecting, live, needs attention), the secure connection (https), and the one record to change, in plain words and in the DNS provider's own menu terms when the provider is known, with its own guide link. At most one fresh look at public DNS per domain every 5 minutes; a call in between returns the last look and the time the next fresh one can run. Each account has an hourly allowance (30 fresh looks, 10 while the app is in Development only). Each fresh look is on the founder's Logs. Changes nothing.
